note: Eight fresh single-node K3s fixtures on native runners. Candidate components are pulled through a fixture TLS registry with preserved OCI digests. The predecessor uses actual verified public 0.4.1 binaries, chart and GHCR images. This is separate from real mixed-cluster acceptance.
